tips.label: 忍不住做某事
tips.text: can't / couldn't help but + 原形動詞

tips.label: 時態判斷
tips.text: 現在或一般情況用 can't；過去的情況用 couldn't。but 後面的動詞一律使用原形。

notes.title: can't / couldn't help but 的用法
notes.rule: 主詞 + can't / couldn't help but + 原形動詞
notes.description: 此句型表示「忍不住……；情不自禁……」。can't 用於現在或一般情況，couldn't 用於過去。help but 後面必須接原形動詞，不接 V-ing、過去式或 to V。
examples: I can't help but laugh at his jokes.
She couldn't help but cry when she heard the news.
We can't help but appreciate his kindness.
